messages:
rita - design: dropped a new confirm modal exploration that tries to make Rotate vs Revoke semantics explicit. can you eyeball copy + keyboard flow? figma: https://figma.com/file/clarify-rotate-revoke

omar - eng: quick backend constraints: rotate issues a new secret and by default leaves the old one live for an undo window. revoke is immediate and emits audit.event.revoke. need the UI to be explicit about audit logging and TTLs.

sam - ux: main UX problem we keep seeing is users thinking rotate deletes old credentials. propose a tiny 2-line explainer under the modal title: "Rotate: issues a new key and keeps the old one live for a short grace period. Revoke: permanently invalidates the key." Keep simple.

kai - product: +1. also add a small FAQ link in the modal: "How is rotate different from revoke?" that expands one paragraph. users with compliance concerns will read it.

rita - design: added inline examples and a small timeline visualization showing the old key expiry after rotation. can someone confirm the undo window we should show?

sys-bot: config:keys.rotation_undo_seconds=900 (15m) for hosted; enterprise orgs may override via org.settings.rotation_undo_seconds. audit: rotation and undo events logged to audit.events.v1.

omar - eng: confirm we surface timezone in schedule preview. show both local and UTC. backend returns schedule_at in ISO with timezone info. UI must not drop tz.

sam - ux: accessibility: the modal should use role=alertdialog for destructive confirmations and trap focus. keyboard order must be: title -> explainer -> schedule options -> reason input -> primary CTA -> cancel. ensure primary CTA is disabled until user types a short reason if revoke is selected.

rita - design: will update order. thinking about CTA copy: change dynamic text to "Rotate key now" or "Schedule rotation" and for revoke use "Revoke key permanently". shorter is better.

kai - product: also add a permissions affordance: if the user lacks key.manage, replace CTA with "Request rotation" that opens a prefilled request modal (org, key id, suggested text). avoids needless support tickets.

omar - eng: we can prefill and call /v1/requests with {type: "key.rotation", key_id, reason}. include API snippet in docs:

POST /v1/requests
{ "type": "key.rotation", "key_id": "k_123", "reason": "scheduled infra update" }

helga - support: request flow is good. please make the request modal show approver and estimated response SLA (e.g., "Admins will be notified; expected response within 24h"). reduces follow-ups.

sam - ux: microcopy nit: when showing the secret after rotate show a clear single-line: "Secret shown once. Copy now or it will be hidden." and the copy button should have aria-live confirmation. If the modal closes immediately, ensure live region existed beforehand to be announced.

rita - design: note: we also want a small "Recent callers" list (last 3 clients) to help users decide if rotation is safe. backend can return client_id and name only. ok?

omar - eng: yes we'll return last_clients: [{client_id, display_name, last_seen}] but we can't show IP addresses. limit to 3 for perf.

kai - product: empty state tweak: after revoking the last key the keys list shows "No active credentials". UX research suggests a short checklist with 3 actions: Create API key, Set rotation policy, Review audit logs. collapse by default and add a one-click "Set rotation" that pre-fills 30d.

sam - ux: prefer CTA text "Set rotation policy (30d)" so intent is explicit. also add a tiny tooltip explaining operational impact.

helga - support: add a help link in the empty state: "What to do after revoking a key" with steps to update clients. that reduces tickets.

rita - design: color/accessibility: using both icon + shape for status pills (Active, Disabled, Revoked) for colorblind safety. will run a checkbox of contrast and colorblind sims.

sam - ux: keyboard accessibility: rows in the keys table must support Enter to open and Space to select for bulk actions. tri-state header checkbox and aria-live announcement for counts.

omar - eng: localization: avoid shorthand like "1h" in selectors. use localized strings "1 hour" so translations are clear. also ensure schedule preview shows both local TZ and UTC like: "Scheduled for 2026-05-05 09:00 (CEST) / 2026-05-05 07:00 UTC".

kai - product: final copy ask: in the revoke flow include a brief line about recovery: "Revoked keys cannot be recovered. To restore access create a new key and update clients. Audit log will list the user who revoked the key."

sam - ux: one more: add a small inline dry-run toggle for bulk rotate that shows a preview of affected clients and writes a short CSV export of the preview for ops teams. keep the preview limited (first 100 rows).

omar - eng: we'll support dry_run up to 100 keys with endpoint:

POST /v1/keys/bulk_rotate?dry_run=true
{ "key_ids": ["k_...","k_..."] }

rita - design: great. i'll push v2 with the clarified copy, role=alertdialog, schedule preview with tz, and the request flow. tagging accessibility and support for review. :sparkles:

sys-bot: reminder: design + accessibility sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
